note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(有效交流主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文3句+3题,答案转述非照抄,覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: Before his first online interview, Daniel arranged his camera so that the light fell on his face rather than behind him. He looked straight into the lens, spoke a little more slowly than usual, and paused now and then to let his answers settle. By the end, the manager said he had seemed remarkably calm and clear, even through a small screen.

questions.q: Why did Daniel make the light fall on his face?
options: To avoid appearing as a dark shape on screen
To make the room feel warmer
To save electricity during the call
questions.explanation: 把光打在脸上是为了不显得像屏幕上的暗影,选项是对原文意图的转述。

questions.q: What did Daniel do while answering questions?
options: He shouted to be heard clearly
He paused at times so his words could sink in
He read every answer from a script
He looked away from the camera
questions.explanation: 他不时停顿,让回答被听者消化吸收。

questions.q: How did the manager describe Daniel at the end?
questions.explanation: 经理说他显得十分镇定清晰,'calm and clear' 的转述。
